title: Evidence-root registry report pointers dangle in-tree
claim: docs/eval/evidence-roots.jsonl 'report' fields reference docs/eval files removed from the checkout by commit d42a7a0 (including the current qualifying 2026-09-29 acceptance root's recollection report and the 2026-09-27 longrun report), so in-tree resolution of those pointers fails and only Git history at the removal commit resolves them.

evidence.detail: Entries for phase19-acceptance-20260929 and phase19-longrun-validation-20260927 carry report paths absent from HEAD.
Only README.md and evidence-roots.jsonl exist; commit d42a7a0 removed the 30 detailed operator reports stating 'registry unchanged'.
Documents the removal convention: reports 'remain readable in Git history at the removal commit'; disclosure also in CHANGELOG Unreleased/Changed.

reproduction: python3 -c "import json;[print(json.loads(l)['report']) for l in open('docs/eval/evidence-roots.jsonl')]" then check each path exists
